41: Keep silence before me, islands, and let the peoples renew their strength.
Don't you be afraid, for I am with you. Don't be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

29: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says Yahweh, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

3: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
He came to him by night, and said to him, "Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him."
Jesus answered him, "Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can't see God's Kingdom."
For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

4: I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
